notes: Encoded independently from this page's own text only, no usesStylesOf and no content imported from any sibling brand file. The page heading lists Peerless, Pinnacle, Purefire and Pavillion under PB Heat, LLC; the body text names Peerless, Pinnacle and Purefire. Page Style 3 (6-digit serials, pre-1984, contact Peerless) is held, not encoded: the page states no serial rule for it. Style 1 list-header form 339030-200012 differs from the section form 339090-200012 in one prefix digit; both decode identically from the shared last-six suffix and both are carried as examples.

styles.era: 12-digit serials (dash stripped by normalization); year and month in the last six digits
styles.notes: Page states the last six digits represent the year and month, in that order. Read as 4-digit year then 2-digit month: 200012 gives year 2000, month 12. The reversed reading (month-year) is falsified: it would give month 20, invalid. Examples are the page's own serials with the dash stripped by normalization; expected values are derived from the page-stated positions, not stated on the page.

styles.era: 10-digit serials (dash stripped by normalization); month and year in the last four digits
styles.notes: Page states the last four digits represent the month and year, in that order: 1284 gives month 12, year 84 resolving to 1984 under the 1960 floor. The reversed reading (year-month) is falsified: it would give month 84, invalid. Example is the page's own serial with the dash stripped; expected values are derived from the page-stated positions.
